details: The US Producer Price Index (PPI) for October registered an annual increase of 6.5%, marking the fastest pace since November 2022. While the monthly increase showed a slight cooling, this persistent elevation in wholesale prices strengthens market expectations for the Federal Reserve to implement further interest rate hikes, potentially a quarter or half-point, at its upcoming December meeting. Such monetary tightening typically makes traditional, interest-bearing assets more attractive, reducing the appeal of speculative assets like cryptocurrencies.
title: US Wholesale Inflation Rises to 6.5%, Bolstering Fed Rate Hike Expectations

details: Bitcoin experienced a sharp sell-off, falling below $66,000 and reaching its lowest levels since August. This significant market downturn was exacerbated by the liquidation of over $1.29 billion in leveraged cryptocurrency positions across various exchanges within a 24-hour period, with long positions accounting for the majority. Adding to the selling pressure, US spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) recorded a seventh consecutive day of significant outflows, indicating a clear increase in risk aversion among investors.
title: Bitcoin Plummets Below $66,000 Amid Mass Liquidations and ETF Outflows
